provenance.source_name: USDA Ag Data Commons & Journal of Agriculture and Food Research (Meng et al., 2025)
provenance.authors: Qingwu Meng, Kishan Biradar, Yujin Park, Patrick N. Kelley (University of Delaware)
provenance.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication) / Open Data Commons
provenance.redistribution_status: Publicly accessible unrestricted open research data; raw multi-gigabyte greenhouse logs remain in external USDA repository

split_protocol.leakage_prevention: Consecutive 10-minute greenhouse readings exhibit intense temporal auto-correlation. Contiguous 6-hour time-blocks (110 total) are partitioned atomically to prevent neighbouring readings from crossing split boundaries.
split_protocol.test_selection: 22 whole 6-hour blocks from original holdout (280 rows, 20.0%)
split_protocol.validation_selection: 11 whole 6-hour blocks held out from train split (162 rows, 14.46% of pool)

cleaning_steps: Subsampled 1,400 rows structured into balanced 7 classes (200 rows per class)
Each non-normal sample breaks exactly one rule and keeps every other parameter in healthy band
Computed contiguous 6-hour time blocks (bench | date | hour // 6)

derived_synthetic_flags.synthetic_rationale: Water temperature, pH, and EC are simulated; relative humidity is adjusted for high mildew class; air temperature is 100% real measured greenhouse logger data.

known_limitations: Hybrid dataset: Solution chemistry is mathematically synthesized; models reflect synthetic thresholds rather than biological plant responses
Unpaired modality: No spatial or temporal pairing with spinach leaf photographs
tds_ppm is derived from EC with noise and must be excluded from model inputs
